_comment: The one definition of the reviewer feedback on OpenCodeReview findings: the poster renders the legend under every finding from it, and marvin7122/ocr-runners feedback/collect.py and propose.py read reactions and reply keywords with it. Change meanings only here. Keywords with "feedback": false are commands of the apply-replies flow (marvin7122/qlever .opencodereview/apply_replies.py), not feedback on the finding; "scope": "pr" marks those posted as a PR comment instead of a reply.

reactions.meaning: improvement potential (right idea, the comment should be better)

legacy_reactions.reason: Version 1 of the legend defined 😕 as "not actionable". A 😕 made before the cut-over (the first commit of this file with version 2 on the default branch) keeps that meaning.

keywords.meaning: correct, but not worth acting on
how this comment should be better
apply the change proposed in this thread
drop the change proposed in this thread
(as a PR comment, not a reply) act on all reactions and replies: mechanical fixes are committed, behavior changes are proposed for /approve
